fixed_data_comparison.limit: The fixed-data comparator is bounded to extracted profile fields and does not certify complete sheet behavior or playable army legality.

scope: Exact one-model, 90-point profile, 40 mm base, source characteristics and keywords; current local construction admits one to three copies and rejects four.

Default rifle and power weapon plus all three source replacement packages are exposed through the public preparation choice. Each replacement equips the Boltstorm Gauntlet and one Extra Attacks relic; all weapon profiles pass Equipment and AttackPlan checks.

Both players materialize from the current consolidated Space Marines catalogs. The Leader map matches the four common-book targets: Aggressors, both Eradicator configurations and Heavy Intercessors. The separate Deathwatch Indomitor Kill Team target is outside the common-book 85.

Strategic Acumen is owner-checked, chooses an active Combat Doctrine in the Command phase, is used once in that phase, persists through the opponent Command phase and expires at the start of the next own Command phase.

Refuse to Yield reduces allocated attack Damage against the Captain model by one, with a minimum of one for positive Damage; the attached bodyguard does not inherit the reduction. The integrated attack allocation path and the historical implementation boundary are checked.
Transhuman Strategist grants one CP once per battle round when the Captain is the Warlord.
